Terms & Conditions

Free to use, with common-sense limits. Last updated: September 2026.

1. What VatSnap is

VatSnap is a free, unofficial VAT rate calculator for small online sellers. Rates are bundled at build time from the open-source eu-vat-rates-data package (source: European Commission TEDB). We aim for accuracy but make no guarantee that any rate is current or applicable to your situation.

2. Not tax advice

Everything on this site is general guidance, not professional tax, legal, or accounting advice. VAT treatment depends on place of supply, customer status, product category, thresholds, and exemptions that a calculator cannot know. Always confirm with a qualified adviser or the official EU source before invoicing or filing. You use the results at your own risk.

3. Acceptable use

  • Use the calculator and country pages for lawful purposes.
  • Do not attempt to disrupt the site, scrape it abusively, or misrepresent it as an official EU source.
  • Do not remove or obscure the "guidance only" disclaimers when quoting results.

4. Embedding

You may embed the free mini calculator via the snippet on our Embed page on any lawful website. Please keep the "Powered by VatSnap" link intact so the free service can sustain itself. We may change or retire the embed endpoint at any time.

5. Intellectual property

Site design and explanatory text are ours. VAT rates themselves are facts sourced from the open dataset described above — see the linked package and EU TEDB for their licensing.

6. No warranty & liability limit

The site is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from use of, or reliance on, the calculator or its rates — including incorrect filings, missed deadlines, or business decisions.

7. Changes

We may update these terms at any time by posting a new version here. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept them.

8. Contact

Questions about these terms? Reach us via the Contact page.
